en.general: A machine learning system that produces new content, such as text, images or sound, from patterns it learned from many examples. In cultural terms it can add variation by recombining existing traits into new combinations. Wording for students: a machine that makes new things out of what it has seen.

examples: An image generator that combines the look of an avocado and an armchair into a new picture.
